propositions: Convergence tests that re-derive the send path behavior instead of driving the real call site and capturing its output remain green when the production send path drifts, defeating the test's purpose

The re-derived oracle defect occurred twice in the same module: first with truncate_comment_body model going stale, then with a fix that reintroduced the same mistake pattern via fit_preserving_marker composition
Concrete send-path convergence defect was already fixed in commit 103729e90c by capturing --body argument from real acli_cli_ops.add_comment call with only acli_subprocess._run_acli stubbed
Test-design guardrail documentation must record the rule that convergence test assertions must capture external-effect sides from real call sites rather than re-deriving them via helper composition

A mechanical lint check to flag re-derived oracles cannot be implemented without unacceptable false positives across 17 legitimate test files where the sanctioned characterization shape is syntactically identical to the defective shape
